FN-EJL6829-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 82
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Larry Stutts
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/20/2026
Senate Bill 82 as introduced would decrease certificate of need (CON) receipts to the State
Health Planning and Development Agency (SHPDA) by an undetermined amount dependent on
the number of rural health care providers located outside of a metropolitan statistical area,
pursuant to the provisions of this bill, beginning October 1, 2026 that would no longer need a
CON to: (1) propose, acquire, construct, operate, furnish or offer a new institutional health
service; or (2) arrange or commit to the financing of a new institutional health service.
According to SHPDA, the average annual application fees collected from facilities classified as
rural was $50,000 based on fiscal year 2024 and fiscal year 2025 data.
